ul.li: IDS path: behaviour signal ⇒ compromise ⇒ epoch ⇒ every cache flushed
Denial path: lateral-movement and breaker attempts are denied; each denial lowers trust until even telemetry falls below the floor — often before the IDS fires
invalidate-on-deny makes the second path work through a cache

text.tspan: IDS path: behaviour signal ⇒ compromise ⇒ epoch ⇒ every cache flushedDenial path: lateral-movement and breaker
attempts are denied; each denial lowers trust until even telemetry falls below the floor — often before the IDS
firesinvalidate-on-deny makes the second path work through a cache

div.b: Only the compromised device is affected

ul.li: trust is per subject; honest PMUs keep high trust and their cached allows
the epoch flush costs every PEP one round trip per subject, then the cache refills
operators can clear a compromise only through the audited admin API
